rows.quote: EFFECTIVE AUGUST 29, 1974 - MR. ALFRED A, MORIN "Fred", as he was known to his co-workers, began as a Junior Custodian in the Passios Elementary School on October 5, 1970. Although his tenure with the school system was short, he gave conscientious and commendable service in the performance of his duties as one of the "housekeepers" of the Passios School.

rows.quote: EFFECTIVE AUGUST 31, 1974 - MR. RICHARD H. DUSTIN "Dick" was elected by the Lunenburg School Committee on July 30, 1962, as Assistant Principal of the Passios Elementary School, with duties to begin August 20, 1962. Prior to Lunenburg, he had had previous experience of eighteen years-- 2 years in Wells, Maine; 3 years in Plainfield, Mass. and 13 years (the last 6 as Supervising Principal) in Middlefield, Conn.
